subject: Problem passing a reactive name to cbind

messages.author: b949e0841d7e094b
messages.subject: Problem passing a reactive name to cbind
parts:
Dear all,


If this is strange/incomprehensible, I'll follow up with a minimum working example. But I suspect I'm making an obvious newbie mistake, so let me give the executive summary first.

It's all happing inside server.R

I'm capturing the column name of a dataset with:

selectInput(
      inputId = "inputName" 
      etc.

I can spit it out in a renderPrint({return(input$inputName)})

and it comes out right, for instance if "Name" is the selected colname:

[1] "Name"

I can successfully bind dataframes with:

cbind("Name" = etc.

but if I do this:

cbind(input$inputName = etc.

it's not working.

If I do:

uniqueName <- input$inputName
cbind(uniqueName = etc

It returns "uniqueName" as the colname rather than the desired name that is stored in input$inputName.


Where's the error? Thanks!


P.S. I also tried to do this:

  Read <- reactive({
    id <- input$inputName
    return(list(id=id))
  })

and to do:

cbind(Read()$id = etc.

Also properly printing:

return(Read()$id)

[1] "Name"

but not working with cbind either.

Thanks so much ZJ,

You're right, I'm a newbie.

Not sure I made myself clear (or maybe I'm not understanding your suggestions).

Take your example:

> rownames(d)
[1] "1" "2"

> cbind("Name" = rownames(d), d)
  Name name1 name2
1    1     1     a
2    2     2     b

My problem is that the following is not working:

cbind(input$inputName = rownames(d),d)

where input$inputName returns:

[1] "Name"

Thus: typing "Name" is okay, but input$inputName is not okay.

i.e. I'm trying to use input$inputName as a colname for the newly created column.
